What should I do if the tracking never updates?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking number never updates, this can happen while the courier processes the package.
Allow a few days after shipment for the first scan to appear. Tracking may look inactive until the courier picks up and scans the parcel. 
Check the tracking link regularly on the courier’s official tracking page. Updates often appear when the package reaches key facilities.
If there are still no updates after several days, contact the courier directly using the tracking number to ask about the shipment status.
If tracking remains stalled for 3–5 business days and the courier cannot help, you can email care@nurosym.com with the tracking number so the situation can be reviewed. 
Delays can occur due to courier scanning backlogs, high shipping volumes, weather, or other logistical factors.
